meta.name: twitter-mcp
meta.description: Use when the user wants to install or authorize xurl for X/Twitter, generate "生成X日报", "X日报", "推特日报", or "Twitter digest" from the local xurl CLI, or optionally register/troubleshoot the hosted X MCP bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成每日推特摘要日报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解推特上的重要动态。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate daily Twitter digest reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of important tweets.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 xurl 工具获取你的 X/Twitter 数据，并自动生成中文日报，包含概览、待回复、时间线热点、账号动态、数据缺口和建议动作。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或授权 xurl，或说出“生成X日报”、“X日报”等短语时触发。

say.note: Claude 会收集数据并生成日报。

say.text: 安装并授权 xurl 到我的 Twitter。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成安装和授权。

say.text: 看看我今天有没有未回复的提及。
say.note: Claude 会检查并列出待回复项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the xurl CLI to fetch your X/Twitter data and automatically generate a daily digest in Chinese, including overview, pending replies, timeline highlights, account activity, data gaps, and suggested actions.
howto.when_en: When you ask to install or authorize xurl, or say phrases like "生成X日报" or "X日报" to request an X/Twitter daily digest.

say_en.note: Claude will collect your data and produce the digest.

say_en.text: Install and authorize xurl for my Twitter.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through installation and OAuth.

say_en.text: Check for unread mentions that need a reply.
say_en.note: Claude will scan mentions and verify reply status.
